  COUNT(*) AS n_countries,
  COUNT(LifeExpectancy) AS n_with_le,
  ROUND(AVG(LifeExpectancy), 3) AS avg_life_expectancy
FROM country
WHERE Continent = 'Africa' AND GovernmentForm = 'Republic'
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'All forms containing "Republic"' AS scope,
  COUNT(*) AS n_countries,
  COUNT(LifeExpectancy) AS n_with_le,
  ROUND(AVG(LifeExpectancy), 3) AS avg_life_expectancy
FROM country
WHERE Continent = 'Africa' AND GovernmentForm ILIKE '%republic%'

- 平均值为未加权（每个国家等权重）的算术平均，而非按人口加权；如需按人口加权请告知。
- 本数据为静态示例数据集（无年份信息），数值反映的是数据集快照状态，不能代表当前实际预期寿命。
